apps.subtitle: Download older and removed App Store apps
apps.localizedDescription:
## iPadn 1.9.2

本版本新增「支持 iPadn」页面，改进诊断信息，并修复两个问题。适用于 iOS / iPadOS 17 及更新版本；安装包未签名，请用自己的工具签名后安装。

**支持 iPadn**

- 新增「账号 › 设置 › 支持 iPadn」：iPadn 会一直免费开源、没有广告；如果它帮到了你，可以通过爱发电（支付宝、微信）或 USDT（BEP20）请作者喝杯咖啡，也可以在 GitHub 点个 Star 或帮忙改进翻译。

**下载**

- 修复部分签名方式下下载完成后提示「未能打开文件 CFNetworkDownload_….tmp，因为你没有查看它的权限」（#36）：遇到这种情况会自动改用应用内下载重新下载一次，之后的下载直接在应用内进行，下载时请保持 iPadn 在前台。首次启动时的后台下载检测也会检查文件能否读取。

**诊断**

- 「账号 › 设置 › 维护」新增「复制诊断信息」：在 LiveContainer 等无法弹出分享面板的环境中，可以直接复制后粘贴反馈。
- 诊断信息会记录最近失败的请求：时间、服务器、接口名称和状态码，不包含账号、链接参数或登录凭据，方便定位下载失败。
- Apple 返回 401 时，提示登录可能已失效并建议重新登录账号，不再只显示「网络请求失败」。

**应用图标**

- 修复更新 iPadn 后，主屏幕上仍是之前选择的浅色或跟随系统图标，「设置」里却显示为深色。从本版本起 iPadn 会记住你选择的图标；更新前就遇到这种情况时，在「设置 › 应用图标 › 图标主题」中重新选择一次即可。

**English**

Adds a Support iPadn page under Account › Settings: iPadn stays free, open source and ad-free, and you can buy the author a coffee through Afdian or USDT (BEP20) if you like. Fixes downloads that failed with "you don't have permission to view CFNetworkDownload_….tmp" under some signing tools (#36): iPadn now downloads such packages again inside the app, and later downloads stay there. Diagnostics now record recent failed requests (time, host, endpoint and status only) and can be copied when the share sheet won't open, as in LiveContainer; a 401 from Apple now suggests signing in again. Also fixes Settings showing the dark icon after an update while the Home Screen kept the light or automatic icon; if this happened before updating, choose the icon theme once more in Settings.

更早版本的更新内容见 [Releases](https://github.com/mengangs/ipadn/releases)。

验证：设备 Release 编译与 IPA 检查通过；136 项测试通过，0 项失败，0 项跳过。

apps.name: Mangayomi
apps.subtitle: Read manga, novels, and watch anime
apps.localizedDescription:
## Why 0.9.95 and not 1.0.0?

This release has almost everything planned for 1.0.0: a new design, a rebuilt player and hundreds of fixes. But so much has changed that it needs testing on more devices and libraries than we can cover ourselves.

So 0.9.95 is the last step before 1.0.0. The goal now is stability, not new features. If something breaks or looks wrong, please [open an issue](https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/issues) with your device and app version. 1.0.0 will come once this version has proven solid.

## Highlights

* **Shiori, a new design for the whole app:** every screen has been redrawn on one design system, with new navigation, transitions and an ergonomic pass throughout (#1077).
* **A rebuilt video player:** new controls on phone, desktop and TV, plus video filters, audio delay, and volume, brightness and fit kept between episodes.
* **A tracker with no account:** follow your status, progress, score and dates on the device alone (#1121).
* **Work that keeps going on Android:** downloads, library updates, restores and syncs continue in the background, under one notification (#1092).
* **More control over downloads and updates:** download ahead while reading, download new chapters automatically, and choose which series a library update skips (#1091).

**Before updating:** this is a large release that also touches how your library is stored, so make a backup first (More > Backup and restore).

## Reader

* Zoom with Ctrl (⌘ on macOS) and the mouse wheel; the wheel alone moves a zoomed page.
* With "Navigate to pan" on, tall pages are read row by row before the page turns.
* Split tall images into slices in webtoon mode.
* Choose which chapters next and previous skip: read, filtered or duplicate.
* Rebind the reader's keyboard shortcuts.
* Separate icons for crop borders on and off.
* Pages and zooms follow your finger more closely, and the webtoon strip glides after a fling.
* Decoded images now have a memory limit, so long chapters no longer keep growing in memory.
* Fixed: lost decoded pages for the next chapter when closing the reader, and chapter list rows with a scanlator failing to lay out.

## Video player

* New controls on phone, desktop and TV, with episodes reachable from the top bar and lock and skip under the timeline on mobile.
* **Video filters:** brightness, contrast, saturation, gamma and hue, kept for the next episodes. Gamma is hidden where the video output cannot apply it.
* **Audio delay:** from -5 to +5 seconds.
* Remember volume and brightness between episodes, and keep the fit from one episode to the next.
* New "Turn subtitles on" switch, so episodes can start without subtitles.
* "Use my subtitle style" now really gives the default style back when turned off.
* VAAPI and VDPAU hardware decoding on Linux.
* Rebind the player's keyboard shortcuts.
* Fixed: a freeze in the player's event handling, crashes when chapter marks change, previous and next buttons on mobile, and controls under the camera cutout in landscape.

## Library and browsing

* Swipe sideways to switch between Manga, Anime and Novels, in the library and in Browse.
* Select everything between two entries, in the library and in chapter lists.
* Skip completed series, series with unread chapters or series not started in library updates. The categories' "Skip updates" option now takes effect too.
* The Updates badge counts what was found since you last opened Updates, and clears when you visit.
* Hidden media types are respected everywhere: Browse, Updates, History and the tracker library.
* Browse remembers the Sources or Extensions page picked for each media.
* Recommendation cards use the available space and no longer show HTML tags.
* Fixed: opening Updates and History with orphan chapters, and an empty random entry.

## Downloads

* Download the next 2, 3, 5 or 10 unread chapters while reading.
* Download new chapters after a library update.
* "Delete download after reading" can remove a chapter 1 to 4 back instead, and keeps bookmarked chapters.
* Failed downloads wait before retrying, and follow what a server asks after a 429 or 503.
* Fixed: complete downloads being held back by the series cover, and resumed archives not finishing.

## Tracking

* New on-device tracker, with its own shelf in the tracker library.
* Redrawn tracking card.
* Progress now reaches trackers even if you leave the screen first.

## Extensions

* Updates are found in every repository, and the app says which one they come from. An update from another repository asks for confirmation before it is installed.
* Extension WebViews are hosted for the extension server, including network and media capture.
* Faster extension installs.
* Repositories with empty source lists are supported.
* Fixed: sources that read a setting in their headers failing to install, and video qualities lost with multiple hosters.

## Backup, restore and sync

* Reading time and last-read dates are kept when restoring backups from other apps.
* Anime is kept from backups of unrecognised forks.
* Local archive favorites are included in backups.
* A backup password is only requested when the password is really the problem.
* Refreshing a catalog keeps your reading state, and duplicate chapters are merged safely.
* Fixed: logging in to the sync server on macOS.

## Security and privacy

* **Secure screen:** keep the app out of screenshots and the recent apps preview, always or only in incognito mode.
* **Lock after:** ask to authenticate after 1, 2, 5 or 10 minutes away, or only when the app starts.

## Updates and first launch

* Onboarding starts by asking for your language.
* Clearer update dialog: installed and new version, date, size, sorted notes and what happens next. You will see it from the next update onwards.
* Pre-releases are now ordered correctly when checking for updates.
* New open source licenses screen in About.
* New Persian translation, and the missing strings translated in every language.

## Platforms

* **Android:** fixed a crash where all files access cannot be granted.
* **Android TV:** fixed the Player settings in the anime-only layout, and the repository added on the welcome screen is filed under anime.
* **iOS:** local files stay inside their folder.
* **macOS:** the app icon now fits the system's icon grid.
* **Windows:** sharper 256 px icon, used by the installer too, and more readable crash reports.
* **Linux:** choose which browser opens external links; JPEG is read whichever libjpeg version is installed; fixed webview window crashes.

## Stability and performance

* Faster database queries and lower memory use.
* The next chapter preloads on a new page rather than on every frame.
* A page that lost its data now offers a way back instead of crashing.
* The startup error screen says what to do when the database cannot open.
* Handled errors are now recorded, and developer mode shows them with their details.

## Contributors

Thanks to everyone who contributed to this release: @adobex, @aliafshany, @itsyaba, @Lukas-DS, @matsukiender-star, @MenaHere, @NBA2K1 and @Totara-thib.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/compare/v0.9.9...v0.9.95

apps.name: MiniWatts
apps.subtitle: Battery, charging and thermal instrument
apps.localizedDescription:
Unsigned build — sign it with your own Apple ID before installing.
https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts#install

## 改进

- **温度可以显示为华氏度。** 设置 → 单位 里可选"自动 / °C / °F"。"自动"跟随系统地区，以及"设置 › 通用 › 语言与地区"里的"温度"选项，所以地区使用华氏度的用户升级后会直接看到 °F。App 各页、图表、热力图、悬浮读数、实时活动和小组件都按所选单位显示；原始数据仍显示传感器给出的 °C。(#25)
- **充电预估。** 充电时，功率页会显示充到 80% 和充到 100% 还要多久，以及大约几点。时间根据电量实际上升的速度推算，不依赖电池能量设置；要等电量变化两次才会出现，通常需要几分钟。80% 以后按典型充电曲线估算，只是近似值。(#27)
- **显示版本号。** 设置 → 关于 里显示当前版本，原始数据导出的第一行也带上了版本号。(#27)
- **iPad 布局。** iPad 横屏和 13 英寸竖屏时，各页分成两栏；窄屏时仍是一栏。历史记录里单次充电的详情页在 iPad 上不再横向铺满。(#22)
- **iPad 热力图。** 在 iPad 上，发热页画的是 iPad 的轮廓，各区域按 iPad Pro 11 英寸的内部布局放置：主板在中间，两侧是电芯，充电芯片在 USB-C 接口旁。设备页和设置里的图标也换成了 iPad。(#13, #22)

## 修复

- 发热：CPU 簇（`pACC`、`eACC`）和图像处理器（`ISP`）等传感器以前被归入"其他传感器"，现在算作 SoC，SoC 区域的温度也会把它们算进去。iPhone 11 上 `FrontCameraDie`、`BCMLBSkin` 这类名字连写的传感器以前会被分错区（比如前摄像头被当成机身），现在会先拆词再归类。(#13, #14)
- 适配器页里"单次采样"那段说明以前在中文界面下一直显示英文，现在已有中文。

## 注意

- iPad 相关的改动只在模拟器里验证过，我手上没有 iPad。如果在 iPad 上看到问题，请从 设置 → 原始数据 复制导出并反馈。
- iPad 上"来自充电器"的功率偏低（#13）这次还没有修：要确认其余的输入由哪个传感器测量，需要一份**充电时**导出的原始数据。有 iPad 的话，请在充电时从 设置 → 原始数据 复制导出，贴到 #13。
- 充电预估无法知道是否开启了充电上限或优化电池充电。如果开着，电池会在上限前停下，"充到 100%"的时间就不准。

---

## Improvements

- **Temperatures can be shown in Fahrenheit.** Settings → Units offers Automatic, °C or °F. Automatic follows your region and the Temperature option under Settings › General › Language & Region, so if your region uses Fahrenheit you will see °F straight after updating. Every page, the charts, the heat map, the floating meter, the Live Activity and the widget follow the setting; Raw data still shows the sensors' own °C. (#25)
- **Charge forecast.** While charging, the Power page shows how long until 80% and until 100%, and roughly when. It is worked out from how fast the battery level is actually rising, so it does not depend on the battery energy setting; it appears once the level has moved twice, usually within a few minutes. Past 80% it follows a typical charging curve and is approximate. (#27)
- **Version number.** Settings → About shows the installed version, and the first line of the Raw data dump includes it. (#27)
- **iPad layout.** On an iPad in landscape, and a 13-inch in portrait, every page uses two columns; narrower windows keep one. A session's detail page in History no longer stretches edge to edge on an iPad. (#22)
- **iPad heat map.** On an iPad the Thermal page draws an iPad, with the zones placed as in an iPad Pro 11-inch: logic board down the middle, a battery cell either side, the charge IC by the USB-C port. The Devices page and Settings use iPad icons too. (#13, #22)

## Fixes

- Thermal: the CPU-cluster (`pACC`, `eACC`) and image-processor (`ISP`) sensors used to land under "Other sensors"; they now count as the SoC, and the SoC zone's temperature includes them. On an iPhone 11, run-together sensor names such as `FrontCameraDie` and `BCMLBSkin` were filed in the wrong zone (the front camera as chassis); names are now split into words before they are matched. (#13, #14)
- Adapter: the one-sample note always showed in English in the Chinese interface; it is now translated.

## Notes

- The iPad changes were checked in the simulator only — I do not have an iPad. If something looks wrong on yours, copy the dump from Settings → Raw data and report it.
- The low "from charger" reading on an iPad (#13) is not fixed yet: finding which sensor carries the rest of the input needs a Raw data dump taken **while charging**. If you have an iPad, please copy one from Settings → Raw data while it charges and post it on #13.
- The charge forecast cannot tell whether a charge limit or Optimized Battery Charging is on. If one is, the battery stops short and the time to 100% will be wrong.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts/compare/v1.6.0...v1.7.0
